name: personal-training
description: Training sessions with a coach, in a gym, outdoors, at home or online.

homeVisits.description: True when the seller comes to the buyer's place.

sessions.description: How many sessions the offer includes.

howDealsGo: A session or a set of sessions is paid into escrow, and the buyer releases after each one. Done is the session held for its full length. A timer to the seller, set past each session, pays for sessions held if the buyer goes quiet. Before paying, mention any injury.
